view: Cahokia Monks Mound wide low view from former Grand Plaza, huge broad flat-topped terraced earthen mound clothed in grass, recognizably several asymmetric platforms and gentle sloping sides, prairie foreground and deciduous trees distant, no stone pyramid or restored summit temple or modern stairs.

eras.title: The shape of Monks Mound
eras.caption: Monks Mound rises in broad earthen terraces above the former centre of Cahokia. The buildings once supported by these platforms have disappeared, but the mound and surrounding open ground still convey the scale of a great Indigenous city near the Mississippi.
